answer: The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, held in escrow until finality, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The oasis holds work receipts rather than names, so the beacon of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The summit of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
